pages.title: Cuphead in Hilda Berg Sky Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead winks and gives a thumbs-up in this printable coloring page set in Hilda Berg's sky, with a grinning crescent moon above the surrounding clouds. Small outlined stars fill the gaps around his striped straw and cup handle. The coloring sheet has broad, rounded spaces and relatively few fine details.

pages.title: Cuphead in Bakery Cellar Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Cuphead in a bakery cellar, wearing a buttoned vest and tie while holding a spoon beside shelves of bread and pastries. Rounded brick ovens and a stone floor surround his full figure. The coloring sheet combines wide clothing shapes with smaller cupcake, pie, and masonry details.

pages.title: Cuphead in Dr Kahl Junkyard Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead stands in Dr. Kahl's junkyard in this printable coloring page, holding a small bent straw beneath a towering robot surrounded by broken mechanical parts. Large gears, pipes, and scattered metal fragments fill the space around him. The coloring sheet includes many angular sections and narrow machinery details alongside his broad character outline.

pages.title: Cuphead in Funhouse Frazzle Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead spreads his arms in this printable coloring page set in Funhouse Frazzle, standing before a curved doorway surrounded by balloons, spirals, and outlined stars. Visible gears and unusual door shapes add to the funhouse setting. The coloring sheet mixes broad gloves and cup shapes with smaller decorative curves around the cropped figure.

pages.title: Cuphead in Circus Tent Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Cuphead inside a circus tent, wearing a large bow tie and waving beneath draped fabric with small banners overhead. Tied-back curtains frame his smiling figure on a wooden platform. Wide tent panels and clothing shapes offer open areas, while folds and floorboard lines add finer sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead in Root Pack Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead stands among the Root Pack in this printable coloring page, smiling above a garden bed with a crying onion, scowling carrot, and cheerful potato. Leafy stems surround his shoes beside a small watering can and rake. The coloring sheet includes distinct facial expressions, enclosed leaves, and broad vegetable shapes beneath the main character.

pages.title: Cuphead in Inkwell Isle Four Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Cuphead in Inkwell Isle Four, giving a thumbs-up above a winding path with a small cottage and distant lighthouse behind him. Rounded hills and sparse trees leave the landscape open around his full figure. The coloring sheet adds small windows and leaves to the character's broad coloring areas.

pages.title: Cuphead in Wally Warbles Birdhouse Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead waves from Wally Warbles' birdhouse in this printable coloring page, leaning through a large circular opening beneath a peaked roof built from wooden boards. A short perch projects below the opening, and his other glove rests beside his head. The coloring sheet leaves a plain background around the birdhouse's bold outline and wood grain.

pages.title: Cuphead in Snowy Village Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Cuphead in a snowy village, smiling between small cottages as round snowflakes fall above the paths and snow-covered ground around him. Chimney smoke curls over the rooftops beside bare and evergreen trees. The coloring sheet provides broad snowbanks and character shapes with smaller house windows and roof details.

pages.title: Cuphead in Cagney Carnation Flower Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead stands in Cagney Carnation's flower field in this printable coloring page, raising one fist with the large grinning flower towering behind his striped straw. Smaller flowers with varied expressions rise among long leaves and curved stems. Repeated petals create many enclosed coloring sections around Cuphead's broad figure on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cuphead in Porkrind Shop Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead visits Porkrind's shop in this printable coloring page, smiling in front of a wooden counter while a pig shopkeeper waves from behind the display. Shelves hold a small chest, jars, a lamp, and rolled paper. The coloring sheet pairs Cuphead's broad outline with finer wood grain and compact objects around the shop.

pages.title: Cuphead in Beppi Carnival Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Cuphead at Beppi's carnival, standing with his hands on his hips beneath floating balloons with a large Ferris wheel behind him. A carousel horse and pointed tent flank his close-up figure. The coloring sheet gives his cup and gloves broad spaces beside smaller ride components and floorboard lines.

pages.title: Cuphead in King Dice Casino Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead waves inside King Dice's casino in this printable coloring page, standing at a curved gaming table while the smiling dice-headed host appears behind him. Dice, card symbols, and a large hanging light decorate the room. The coloring sheet includes small pips and table divisions around Cuphead's broad, raised glove.

pages.title: Cuphead in Rugged Ridge Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Cuphead in Rugged Ridge, bracing with both fists raised between steep cliffs and pointed mountains under a mostly open sky. Scattered rocks and sharp ledges surround his wide stance. The coloring sheet combines large character shapes with angular rock faces and a few narrow cracks in the landscape.

pages.title: Cuphead in Candyland Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead waves in Candyland in this printable coloring page, standing before a giant spiral lollipop, striped candy cane, and rounded hills with dripping icing shapes. A small chocolate bar and gumdrops sit among the bushes. The coloring sheet offers broad, simple spaces on Cuphead and the hills, with a few repeated candy patterns.

pages.title: Cuphead in Esther Winchester Desert Town Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead stands in Esther Winchester's desert town in this printable coloring page, holding a rounded blaster that sprays droplets beside cacti and a wooden saloon. A raised water tank and distant mesa add details behind his smiling figure. The coloring sheet offers large open areas, with narrower sections in the building and desert plants.

pages.title: Cuphead in Werner Werman House Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Cuphead in Werner Werman's house, pointing across a cluttered workshop while a small mouse waves from a doorway near the floor. Cans labeled cheese, exposed gears, coils, and wooden crates fill the room. Fine wood grain and numerous small objects make the coloring sheet detailed around Cuphead's larger shapes.

pages.title: Cuphead in Grim Matchstick Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead raises one finger in this printable coloring page at Grim Matchstick's tower, standing before a stone window with the smiling dragon wrapped around the battlements. A crescent moon and small cloud sit above the curved neck and wing. The coloring sheet combines broad character areas with individual bricks, scales, and claw details.

pages.title: Cuphead on Phantom Express Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead rides the Phantom Express in this printable coloring page, gripping a large wheel above a locomotive with an angry face and curling chimney smoke. A bell, exposed gears, connecting rods, and a front lamp decorate the engine. The coloring sheet includes many small mechanical sections and broad spaces in Cuphead's cup and shoes.

pages.title: Cuphead in Jazz Club Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuphead plays a saxophone in this printable coloring page set in a jazz club, standing beside a microphone with small tables and chairs behind him. His puffed cheeks and gloved hands emphasize the playing pose against a brick wall. The coloring sheet gives the instrument fine keys and curved sections beside his broader figure.
